object.name: answerWidgetQuery
object.description: Use this method to send an answer to a query from a widget. The query must be answered within 15 seconds. The answer is received only by the widget that sent the query and doesn't change data of the widget; use editMessageWidgetData or editSharedWidgetData to change it. On success, True is returned.
